title: Draft the maintainer pre-check prompt/skill
description: Create an initial version of the prompt (or skill description) that a project maintainer can run to receive an estimated ASCP eligibility score and concrete recommendations before requesting inclusion in the registry. The output should include scores for standardization, job quality, license, activity, and a list of actionable recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: A markdown file exists (suggested path: docs/pre-check-prompt.md) containing the full prompt text
The prompt asks for or assumes access to the project repository and its ascp/ files
The expected output format includes percentage or scores and clear recommendations
The document explains how a maintainer should use it
